subtitle: Puzzles binaris quotidians
short_description: Resolva tavlas binaras cun indizis e progress localmain.
description: Gioga in puzzle quotidian 4×4 Takuzu u tavlas libras 4×4 e 6×6. Lingias e colonnas ston esser equilibradas, na pon avair trais numers identics en ina lingia, e na dastgan avair lingias completadas dubladas. Utilisescha indizis, annullar, refar e reiniziar. Il progress vegn memorisà localmain.
